 The hippocampus has the ability to associate new information with previous experience in order to make sense of the world . It receives sensory input from the senses and motor areas of the brain , and projects the information to other areas of the brain . The hippocampus is one of the three " memory banks " for short @-@ term , or working , memory . The other two are the prefrontal cortex and the anterior cingulate cortex . These three areas work together to perform a variety of tasks , such as forming new memories or recognizing familiar faces . Scientists have found that the hippocampus is one of the most important parts of the brain for forming memories . Damage to the hippocampus can produce a complete loss of new memory ( anterograde amnesia ) , but does not affect existing memories ( retrograde amnesia ) . Amnesia and other memory disorders are common in people with hippocampus damage .

 Due to the proximity of the Moon , the oceans are tidally locked to the Moon 's orbit . The tidal influence is the dominant force shaping the Earth 's oceans . The tides have a large and easily observed impact upon the ocean 's surface , but the same forces also affect the planet as a whole . The gravitational pull of the Moon 's tidal bulge creates an equal and opposite reaction in the Earth , causing the solid planet to bulge slightly at the point farthest from the Moon .  The abolition of slavery and the slave trade in the Ottoman Empire was a gradual process , which lasted from the mid @-@ 19th century until the final abolition in 1909 . The Ottoman Empire was a slave society during the first half of the 19th century . The abolition of slavery was preceded by abolition of the slave trade and then by the reform of laws concerning the status of slaves . In 1857 , the Ottoman Empire outlawed the import and sale of black slaves . Black slaves continued to be kept in the Ottoman Empire after the abolition of the slave trade . By 1880 , the majority of slaves in the Ottoman Empire were women and children . In 1890 , the Ottoman Empire abolished the status of slave and granted equal rights to the women and children of slaves . In 1909 , the Ottoman Sultan Abdülhamid II issued a decree abolishing the status of slave . The abolition of the slave trade was part of the Ottoman policy of modernization that was promoted by the Tanzimat reforms .

 The introduction of jet aircraft in the 1950s spelt the end of the biplane fighter . The biplane 's thick , flat wings gave it poor aerodynamic efficiency . Its low ceiling — the speed at which it would fall from the sky if left unpowered — was also too low to be suitable for jet fighters . A modern jet fighter would reach its ceiling in just a few minutes . It could then dive to intercept an enemy plane before it had even left the airfield . By the 1960s , most of the world 's military biplanes had been retired or converted to other roles . There were a few exceptions : the US Air Force retained the F86E Sabres as trainers and the US Navy 's F4U Corsairs were used for carrier trials to 1962 and in the air @-@ to @-@ air refueling role until 1969 . The South African Air Force used biplanes until the 1970s .

The primary function of the larynx is to control and protect the upper airway . The larynx is the part of the body that is responsible for the human voice , which is produced by the vibration of the vocal cords . The ability to speak is achieved by the muscular action of the vocal cords , which modulate the flow of air from the lungs . Each time the vocal cords move , they change shape and the pressure of air passing through them creates the sound of the human voice . This is achieved by the human vocal tract , which consists of the mouth , the vocal cords , the pharynx , and the nasal cavity .  Adult puffins gather in large numbers on offshore islands to breed. They are monogamous and pair bonds usually last for life . Nesting sites are usually in burrows dug into rocky cliffs , but some may be dug out in the soil or tundra . Nests are lined with grass and feathers , and sometimes moss . 


 Both adults usually incubate the single egg which hatches after about a month . After hatching , the chick is brooded by the female while the male goes to sea to feed . Puffins regurgitate oily fish to their chicks , but the chicks are fed on a more diverse diet than adults . 


 The chick leaves the burrow when it is 5 – 6 weeks old , and is fed out at sea by both parents for another six weeks until it is able to fend for itself .

Later modalists have attempted to refute the Arian objection that God could not be both omniscient and omnipotent , while at the same time arguing that there was only one God who manifested himself in different modes . In the modern world , a different form of modalism has become popular among certain Pentecostals and charismatics . The Tongva , originally hunters and gatherers , became farmers as the Spanish introduced maize ( corn ) to the region . The climate of the Los Angeles region was relatively dry before European settlement , with a relatively brief wet season from November through April , and a dry season from May through October . In this dry period , many plants went dormant or lost their leaves . When the water came back , the plants flowered and then dried out again . The Native Americans of the region learned to use the seasonal cycle for their benefit , timing their planting of crops to make the most of the rainy season , when the soil was wet . They had a variety of techniques for growing maize ( also known as corn ) , beans , squash , chile peppers , and other crops . The Native Americans also learned how to use local native plants for dyes for clothing , basketry , and other crafts . 


 In the Tongva language , the name of Los Angeles is Yaangna . The indigenous people used the Los Angeles River for transportation , communication , and a source of food .

 The North Dakota Badlands , like many Badlands regions around the world , were formed by erosion of soft sedimentary rock layers over tens of millions of years . In the Badlands , the process started around 60 million years ago , when the Western Interior Seaway became separated into the modern Pacific and Atlantic Oceans . This separation created a " rain shadow " effect that allowed the Great Plains to become drier , with less vegetation . 


 During the Cenozoic era , the Missouri River flowed northward through the area , where it deposited sediment from the eastern Black Hills . Eventually the river shifted westward , leaving the Badlands as a valley . The area was largely covered with a shallow sea , called the Belle Fourche Sea , that left a large limestone deposit known as the Fort Pierre Formation , a deposit that forms the bottom layer of the Badlands . Around 30 million years ago , the sea receded , leaving a low plain that had some vegetation , and some hills that had even less vegetation . The vegetation consisted of grasses , flowering plants , and trees .

After the 1848–1849 German Revolution , Austria 's political position was weakened and Prussia took the opportunity to reorganize the German states . At the 1850 Frankfurt Parliament , the German States had agreed to make a German federation with a Prussian King and Prussian army . It was during the process of negotiating the constitution of this new German Confederation that Austria lost its claim to the German crown . The negotiations had failed and a war was inevitable . The Prussians agreed to a treaty on 22 April 1850 which stipulated Austria 's right to the German throne in return for recognition of the status quo and the creation of a German Confederation . On 26 June 1850 , Schwarzenberg received the news that the Austrian foreign ministry had received , but the treaty was leaked to the public before the King could sign it . The treaty was a great humiliation for Austria as the German states had been pressured into accepting the treaty by Prussia .

The evolution of the horse was a major evolutionary event in the Tertiary , but horses were absent from Europe and North America during this period .

 The idea of a thing being what it is has been a part of human understanding for millennia . In Plato 's dialogues the concept of identity is discussed extensively . Plato 's Theory of Forms has been influential in the western world ; one consequence has been that people have taken for granted that identity is a matter of kind : identity as a matter of property . This has the effect that a thing retains its identity even if all of its properties change . In contrast , the Buddhist approach to identity is ontological and sees identity as matter of relation . The Buddhist approach sees identity as a matter of relations between entities . This has the effect that a thing can change its identity through changes in relations . Buddhist concepts of identity are influenced by Madhyamaka philosophy and have been an important aspect of Chinese Buddhism . In Europe , these concepts have been influenced by the concept of the thing in itself developed by Leibniz and Kant .

 Kuhn 's 1962 book , The Structure of Scientific Revolutions , in which he introduces his ideas about paradigms and scientific revolutions , was equally influential . In his book , he defines a paradigm as the entire constellation of beliefs , values , techniques , and so on shared by the members of a given scientific community . He argues that as long as a scientific community is generally satisfied with its current state of affairs , it will not tend to make radical changes , but will rather focus on minutely developing and refining its current paradigm , or model of the world . If a crisis comes and the community 's " shared framework for science " is destroyed , then a revolution in scientific thought will occur , and a new paradigm will emerge to replace the old one . He also proposed the concept of " normal science " , or the activity that occurs within a given paradigm during routine times .
